newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: De Beers posts glittering H1 results.
newsitem.headline: De Beers posts glittering H1 results.

text.p: De Beers Consolidated Mines Ltd lifted attributable earnings for the half year to end-June 1997 to $507 million from $482 million a year ago.
De Beers and its international arm De Beers Centenary AG said after taking into account taxation of $156 million, up from $105 million a year, its combined earnings was $507 million.
Its diamond account -- profit from trading and selling diamonds -- increased to $510 million from $447 million in the same period last year.
De Beers said combined earnings including the share of retained earnings of associates, were $775 million from the $683 million in the previous six months.
De Beers declared an interim dividend of 27.4 U.S. cents, slightly up from the previous 27.0.

It said the 1997 interim earnings included an exceptional item of $75 million comprising the De Beers group's surplus which arose from the disposal of a portion of its interest in mining house JCI Ltd, less a provision in respect of an anticipated loss on the disposal of its interest in Lonrho plc.
Analysts polled by Reuters forecast net attributable earnings of between $510 and $543 million.
